data.description: The first layer of a destination shaped by nature: a welcoming arrival, places to stay, water and landscape.
data.narrative: প্রথম Phase-এই আমরা এমন একটি core resort destination তৈরি করার পরিকল্পনা করছি, যেখানে customer hotel, villa, restaurant, swimming pool, lake এবং nature-based recreation একসঙ্গে পাবেন।
data.purpose: Forest ECO Resorts-এর foundation এবং প্রথম পর্যায়ের operational destination তৈরি করা।
data.summary: Phase 1 builds the heart of the resort: a hotel, private villas, a restaurant and café, a swimming pool and a lake, set within nature-based recreation. It is the foundation of Forest Eco Resort and its first operational destination.

data.description: A new rhythm of recreation, business and open-air leisure, centred around golf practice and a driving range.
data.narrative: Forest ECO Resorts-এর Phase–2-তে আমরা Golf & Lifestyle Zone যুক্ত করছি। এখানে Golf Practice Facility, Driving Range, Golf Academy এবং Clubhouse-এর পাশাপাশি Convention ও Corporate Event Facilities থাকবে।
data.summary: Phase 2 adds a Golf & Lifestyle Zone: a golf practice facility, driving range, golf academy and clubhouse, alongside convention and corporate event facilities.

data.description: A broader family destination, bringing together premium hospitality, water recreation and entertainment.
data.narrative: Phase–3-তে Forest ECO Resorts আরও বড় একটি luxury family destination হিসেবে develop হবে—যেখানে premium hotel, luxury villa, water recreation এবং indoor entertainment facilities থাকবে।
data.concept: Luxury Stay + Family Entertainment + Water Recreation
data.summary: Phase 3 grows the resort into a larger luxury family destination, with a premium hotel, luxury villas, water recreation and indoor entertainment.

data.description: The culmination of the vision: intimate retreats, restorative spaces and considered hospitality.
data.narrative: Phase–4 হবে Forest ECO Resorts-এর signature luxury zone—যেখানে Presidential Villa, Luxury Suite, Wellness, Spa, Fine Dining এবং premium lifestyle facilities নিয়ে একটি exclusive destination তৈরি করা হবে।”
data.summary: Phase 4 is the signature luxury zone: presidential villas, luxury suites, wellness, a spa, fine dining and premium lifestyle facilities, together forming an exclusive destination.
